info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Deposit Lending Corporate Current Account-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of corporate current accounts within the deposit lending framework. Businesses can initiate the onboarding process for corporate clients, allowing them to manage their financial operations effectively. Typically utilized by banking institutions and financial service providers, this API streamlines account setup and integrates seamlessly with existing banking systems. It ensures compliance and enhances user experience, enabling efficient management of corporate banking needs.

post.summary: Create a deposit for a corporate current account.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a deposit associated with a corporate current account. Ensure that all required information for the deposit is included in the request body to process the transaction successfully.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a transaction for creating or updating a corporate current account under the deposit lending service. The payload must conform to the specified schema and contain all required fields to process the request.

201.description: Resource for corporate current account created successfully.
